instruction: Enable the mirror video effect in VLC to flip the video horizontally.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling video effects in VLC (Tools > Effects and Filters > Video Effects > Geometry > Transform or Interactive Zoom). The evaluator checks VLC's configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) for video effect/filter settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly uses AND logic: Line 79 combines (has_transform_filter AND transform_type_is_hflip) OR has_mirror_filter OR has_mirror_mode_horizontal
Transform filter case uses proper AND verification: Only sets mirror_enabled=True when BOTH 'transform' is in video-filter AND transform-type is 'hflip' or '1'
Multiple detection methods handled correctly: Supports both transform-based mirror (with AND logic), standalone mirror filter, and mirror-mode settings
No false positive risk: If video-filter contains 'transform' but transform-type is 'vflip' or 'rotate', mirror_enabled will remain False because the AND condition won't be satisfied
Metric function is correct: Simple boolean comparison of expected vs actual mirror_enabled status
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies the instruction requirement of enabling horizontal flip mirror effect
State accessibility verified: VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) persists settings and is accessible after effects are applied
Expected value semantically correct: mirror_enabled=true matches instruction requirement
